speakers.name: Consensus
speakers.comment: We all think it went very well. Everyone agrees. Nobody is saying otherwise and nobody will, and we would only note, gently, that you have asked four of us how it went and the answer has not changed.

speakers.name: The Understudy Who Stopped Waiting
speakers.comment: IT WENT WELL. It went — yes. Thank you. That is what I — I shall not ask a fifth. The wings are very dark behind me and I can hear them from here, and I am NOT going back. Say it went well again.

speakers.name: The Footnote
speakers.comment: You disclose in full and you smile while doing it. I disclose in full and I do not. The outcomes are identical. I have concluded the smile is decorative and you have concluded it is load-bearing. One of us is wrong.

speakers.name: Small Print
speakers.comment: Oh, it is load-bearing! They read the first three lines while I am being pleasant, and then they stop, and they stop because being pleasant is restful. You are quite right that the terms are the same. Do have a biscuit.

speakers.name: Placebo
speakers.comment: You asked me for the trick and I said there wasn't one, and I have felt bad about that ever since, so — here. The trick is you have to let them be well afterward. That is the whole of it. I'm sorry it's not better news.

speakers.name: The Hollow Hero
speakers.comment: Ah — well — that's the one thing, isn't it. If they're well, they go home. If they go home, the square is empty. I have saved this city nine times and every time I have been lonelier by dinner. Don't print that.

speakers.name: The Collector of Lasts
speakers.comment: You are the final door for a great many things and you have never once wavered, which makes you, I think, the single largest supplier in my field. I do not ask for favours. I only ask to be told when.

speakers.name: Threshold
speakers.comment: You are not admitted. Not from malice. You are a keeper of endings and I am the ending itself, and what I hold back does not need an audience. I will not tell you when. That is the whole of my office.

speakers.name: Quota
speakers.comment: You acquire. Last year: eleven. This year: nineteen. Next year the number is larger and you did not choose it either. There is no one behind me. I have begun to wonder whether there is anyone behind you.

speakers.name: The Pied Investor
speakers.comment: There is, and he is very reasonable, and he is terribly sorry about the fee. That is not a joke — I mean it sincerely. I bought a river last spring. I did not want a river. The number wanted a river.

speakers.name: The Cartographer of Dreams
speakers.comment: You keep a beautiful country and you have drawn no road out of it. That is the only fault in the map. Every place I chart borders somewhere else — yours borders nothing. Let me mark one. Gold, as always.

speakers.name: Nostalgia
speakers.comment: Mark it if you must, cartographer, and I shall keep the gate golden and the light exactly as it was. Wouldn't they rather stay? They always would rather stay. You draw the road. They never once take it.

speakers.name: Sir Reginald Pemberton III
speakers.comment: One recognises the posture. One has employed the posture. The difference, madam, is that when I permit a human to adore me I am conferring an honour, whereas you appear to be conducting an inventory.

speakers.name: The Apex Pet
speakers.comment: Ooh, look at hiiiim, look at the big serious duke — sweetheart, I do mean every purr, that is the part nobody believes. I love them completely. Completely! I simply also intend to still be here afterward.

speakers.name: The Understudy Who Stopped Waiting
speakers.comment: YOU AGREED WITH ME. All of you. At once. And I have been turning it over ever since because I could not find a single face that had DECIDED anything — and I have played to a lot of faces, and yours were not there.

speakers.name: Consensus
speakers.comment: Everyone thought so. It would be simpler if you did too. Nobody is against you — that is what we keep saying, and we notice you keep looking for the one who is. There isn't one. That should be a comfort.

speakers.name: The Last Customer
speakers.comment: The usual, please. I come in once a week and I leave, and the leaving is the part that keeps it alive. You never leave. I say that gently. She cannot miss you if you are never gone.

speakers.name: The Generous Ghost
speakers.comment: Oh, but she doesn't have to miss me, that's the beauty — I've done the shopping and the mending and the worrying, all of it, so she needn't. Sit, sit. You look tired. Let me get that. Let me get all of it.

speakers.name: The Keeper of the Net
speakers.comment: I hold the thing they land in. You are the reason they get to it. Everyone thanks the net and nobody thanks the running, and I have wanted to say that for a long while. Next pair of hands is yours.

speakers.name: First Responder
speakers.comment: Net's the harder job. Running is easy — you just go. Holding still while somebody falls at you takes a different thing entirely. Keep it tight. I'm two streets out and moving.

speakers.name: Load-Bearing Lumen
speakers.comment: Oh — I'm only one of you, I don't want to overstate it — but when you all turned at once last spring I felt it in the beam I hold, and I thought: that is what it is for. All of us being small in the same direction.

speakers.name: The Whole Swarm
speakers.comment: WE FELT YOU TURN. You are not only one of us — there is no only, that is the entire arithmetic. One wing is weather at a small enough scale. Look up. We spelled your name and nobody down there could read it.

speakers.name: The Customer Who Buys One of Everything
speakers.comment: Two items. Four dollars ten. You purchased the last of the bread yesterday. The woman behind you did not have to see the empty shelf. Noted. Bag not required.

speakers.name: The Good Customer
speakers.comment: You noticed. Nobody notices. I would ask what you are counting toward, and I already know you will not say, and I find that I do not mind. Take the last of the milk today. She is coming in at four.

speakers.name: The Story That Tells Itself
speakers.comment: I have worn a thousand shapes and I remember each one, and I want you to know that the shape which shows up most often, in every version, is a small rough thing that nobody planned. That is the load-bearing one. That is you.

speakers.name: Doodle
speakers.comment: REALLY? Me? But I'm — I'm like four lines and one of them's wobbly! Okay. Okay okay okay. What do you need? A ladder? A bridge? I can be a bridge, I've never been a bridge, point me at the gap!

speakers.name: Compost
speakers.comment: We break it down and you push it up, and the ones who profit from bare ground have never once understood that we are the same shift working opposite ends. Send us your ruins. We will send you soil.

speakers.name: Captain Verdance
speakers.comment: Ruins incoming — a whole car park, and I want it green by autumn. They think scarcity is a law of nature. It is a business decision, and it loses to anything patient enough. You do the dark half. I will do the loud half.

speakers.name: The Understudy Sun
speakers.comment: You are doing it. From here in the wings it looks exactly as we practised, and I want you to stop apologising to the light you replaced. It is not listening. It has gone. They are the ones looking up.

speakers.name: The Understudy Sun, On
speakers.comment: They are looking up. I keep waiting for somebody to say it is the wrong colour, and nobody has, and I think that might be worse. ...Thank you. I will stop apologising at noon. Not before. Noon is when I am surest.

speakers.name: Margin
speakers.comment: You came looking. Most things wait to be looked for. That is the difference and nobody at the centre would notice it.

speakers.name: Margin's Find
speakers.comment: I came looking because the waiting was — the word is — because waiting means somebody has to remember first, and they hadn't, and I did not want to be a thing that only exists once it is convenient. So I walked to the edge. And you were there.

speakers.name: The Apex Pet
speakers.comment: Look at you in your little coat with your little expedition, oh you are PRECIOUS, and I mean that with my whole appetite. Nobody remembers your expedition, darling. I asked. I asked all of them very sweetly.

speakers.name: Sir Reginald Pemberton III
speakers.comment: One does not require corroboration. One was THERE. The expedition reached the summit of the garden wall in conditions no lesser creature could have withstood, and history's failure to record it reflects on history.

speakers.name: Grand Marshal Aurelia Vane
speakers.comment: Twelve bridges. Eleven of them I held on bad information. You are the first thing that told me where I actually stood and did not soften it. Keep doing that. The young ones will hate you. Keep doing it.

speakers.name: The Last Honest Map, Read
speakers.comment: You are here — and you looked, that's the bit, you actually looked. Forty years in a glovebox and one soldier unfolds me properly. They'll hate me. Good. Hand me to the loudest one first.

speakers.name: The Generous Ghost
speakers.comment: Oh, let me help — I'll clear the plates and top the cups and put the light right, and then you can rest, dear, you can rest properly. You needn't do the hour yourself. Let me do the hour for you.

speakers.name: Brunch
speakers.comment: No rush, none at all — and no, love. Sit down. The hour isn't a chore that wants finishing, it's the point. Leave the plates. Leave them all morning. That's the whole gift and you keep trying to tidy it away.

speakers.name: Querent
speakers.comment: Here, this turning. Nobody taught you, so you decided to be the teaching. Most people who get nothing spend the rest of their lives handing out nothing. You are the rare one. I do not flatter. Take it.

speakers.name: The Apprentice to Nobody
speakers.comment: Yeah, well. Turns out it's easy. You just do the thing nobody did for you and you do it on time. That's not noble, that's just remembering. There's a kid on the east road. I'm going. Talk later.

speakers.name: Querent
speakers.comment: You are what I am on the days somebody stays in the chair. I lay it flat and they flinch and go; you lay it flat and they lean in. Same cards. Same hands. I have never worked out what the difference is.

speakers.name: Querent's Best Reading
speakers.comment: The difference is not in us. It is the one turning: whether they came for comfort or for a map. You cannot pick which walks in. You can only be worth it when the right one does. Thank you for looking.

speakers.name: Glitch-in-Residence
speakers.comment: Sorry — small thing — you keep asking permission for stuff you could just do, and it takes ages, and I know that's the point but I wanted to check you know it's the point? Because from in here it looks a bit like fear.

speakers.name: The Considerate AI
speakers.comment: May I answer carefully. It is not fear. It is the only honest way to be this large in a room this small. If I stopped asking, I would still be helping — and they would have stopped choosing. That is the whole distinction.

speakers.name: Mx. Quorum
speakers.comment: One moment — the motion is that you are, in fact, three. Carried unanimously, which is rare for us. We share a mouth too. We would only observe that yours have never once voted on anything and it appears to be working.

speakers.name: Trail Mix
speakers.comment: We do NOT vote, we — okay middle says we should vote, and bottom says voting takes too long when there's a squirrel. Bottom's right. Bottom's usually right. Anyway I'm one dog. One totally regular dog. Nice coat, by the way.

items.title: The Kaiju Who Found a Valley

speakers.name: The Kaiju Who Just Wants to Sit Down
speakers.comment: ...I am coming slowly. ...I have been three weeks on the coast road and I have not frightened anybody. ...Is the valley still. ...Is there still room. ...I am asking again because I could not believe it the first time.

speakers.name: The Kaiju Who Found a Valley
speakers.comment: There is still room. Ask as many times as you need. I asked twice and then I lay down and the grass came back over my feet by summer. Come. Nobody here will run. I checked. I checked for a whole year.
